title: Ninja’s first-ever microwave just replaced two of my kitchen appliances at once | TechCrunch
summary: Ninja has paired a 1,000W microwave with a 1,700W air fryer system, powered by its FusionCrisp technology, which combines the speed of microwave cooking with the golden, crispy results you’d typically expect from an air fryer.
